ada:mappingArea: Raster over "a few millimeters" of polished iron slab surface (area not precisely stated)
ada:signalIntegrationTime: N/A (mapping) / ~20 s (Ge spots: 20 s ablation at 50 Hz)
ada:detectionLimit: LODs not formally reported; all concentrations above detection limits except noted (Cr in some irons below LOD)
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: LA-ICP-MS concentrations agreed with NAA within ±40% for most elements (LA relative to NAA); within ±10% for Ni, Co, Ga; differences in W (4.39 vs 1.06 ng g⁻¹ for Cerro del Inca by LA vs INAA) and Au/As up to 30% — attributed to heterogeneous sampling scale difference between techniques

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Preparation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Polished metal slabs and thin sections; no acid treatment described

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Laser Spot Geometry
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Raster: 50 µm circular beam spot; Spot (Ge): 150 µm circular

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
Analysis Sequence
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Standards at start of session → raster unknowns → repeat → standards at end; separate session for Ge spot analyses

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Uncertainty Propagation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Standard deviation (SD) across individual integration cycles of raster scans; uncertainty propagation not formally described

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Applied: triple mode detection at 65% duty cycle (pulse counting + analog + Faraday); specific cross-calibration not described

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: External calibration with iron meteorite and NIST SRM 1263a V-Cr steel standards; no post-acquisition normalization described

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Primary Calibration Standard Name
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: North Chile Filomena (IIAB iron meteorite; Wasson et al. 1989) for Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/Ga/Ge/As/W/Au; Hoba (IVB; Walker et al. 2008) for Ru/Rh/Pd/Re/Os/Ir/Pt; NIST SRM 1263a V-Cr steel (Campbell & Humayun 2005) for V/Cr/Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/As/Mo/W/Au
